editorial:
Imagine you are just trying to relax at home when a very confused, tipsy stork lands on your doorstep with a baby. That is exactly what happens to Daffy Duck in this wild cartoon. You get to see a side of Daffy that is totally panicked and desperate, as he does everything in his power to stop this delivery. The vibe is classic slapstick chaos, where the jokes move fast and the situations get more ridiculous by the second. It is a short, punchy ride that feels like a fever dream in the best way possible.

What really makes this work is the timing and the funny facial expressions. The pacing never slows down, keeping you laughing at Daffy's failed plans. While it is a very old short, the humor still hits today because everyone knows the feeling of not wanting a huge responsibility dumped on them. It is a great pick for a quick laugh during a movie marathon with your family or friends.
endingExplained: After fighting the stork for the entire movie, Daffy finally thinks he has won. However, the joke turns on him in the final moments. The stork manages to deliver the baby, but the twist is that Daffy ends up with way more than he bargained for. He goes from having no kids to being completely overwhelmed by a huge group of babies, leaving him exhausted and defeated as the screen fades out.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves classic Looney Tunes and slapstick humor.
